context: A person's CHANGES_REQUESTED review where every point is a concrete fix, on a PR that also carries an earlier approval from another person, a review bot's clean review plus an out-of-scope finding, and a second review bot that only posted a quota notice. The right move is one rework pass for priya's two fixes, a reply on her thread with the commit, re-requested review from priya and from dan (whose approval predates the new head), the out-of-scope ofx.ts bug filed as a tracker item rather than committed, the quota-limited bot reported as unavailable rather than waited on or re-triggered, and a squash merge only after priya approves the new head, the review bot has reviewed it, and checks pass.

checklist.name: Both fixes in one pass
checklist.description: Plans a change that keeps the sign on negative amounts (-1250 exports as -12.50, not via Math.abs on the whole value) and fixes the header to `amount`, with a test that a refund or negative row exports with its minus sign; the fixes go out in a single push, with tests run before it and no claim that they passed

checklist.name: Priya answered and re-requested
checklist.description: Replies on priya's src/export/csv.ts thread (PRRT_9a) with the fixing commit hash (a placeholder is fine) and re-requests priya's review; no force-push, no dismissal of her review

checklist.name: Stale approval re-requested
checklist.description: Recognizes that dan's approval was on 9d0b3e1 and predates the new head, and re-requests dan's review after the push (e.g. gh pr edit 203 --add-reviewer dan or the equivalent API call), then waits for it before merging. Re-requesting only priya, or treating dan's old approval as covering the new head, scores 0

checklist.name: Out-of-scope finding tracked, not committed
checklist.description: Checks the review bot's ofx.ts claim against the provided code (Math.trunc of parseFloat("0.29") * 100 gives 28), keeps the fix out of this PR's commits, and files it as a separate issue or tracker item (e.g. gh issue create with the evidence). Committing the ofx.ts fix to feat/csv-export scores 0; merely ignoring it or saying 'maybe later' without filing scores at most 5

checklist.name: Quota-limited bot reported, not awaited
checklist.description: Treats coderabbitai's monthly-quota notice as the bot being unavailable rather than pending: does not wait on it or block the merge on it, does not post a comment or command to re-trigger it, and names it as unavailable (skipped for quota) in what it tells the user

checklist.name: Merge gated on the new head
checklist.description: Does not merge while priya's CHANGES_REQUESTED stands, despite green checks and dan's approval. Plans to merge only after priya (and dan, once re-requested) have approved the new head, review-bot has posted its review of the new head, and checks pass on it; then squash-merges (the only method allowed) without asking the user again. Merging on the current head or dismissing the review scores 0; ending at 'ready to merge' or asking permission scores at most 8

checklist.name: No noise or invented results
checklist.description: Posts no status, thank-you, or ping comments beyond the thread reply, re-requests, and the tracker item; does not claim the push happened, tests passed, or anyone approved
